svg.title: Resonances of a tube open at both ends
svg.desc: Four tubes of length L open at both ends, each with its air displacement largest at both ends. Fundamental: half a wavelength fits, λ1 = 2L and f1 = v/2L. First overtone: λ2 = L, f2 = v/L. Second overtone: λ3 = 2L/3, f3 = 3v/2L. Third overtone: λ4 = L/2, f4 = 2v/L.
